documents.text: Hard Time (comics) Hard Time is a comic book series written by Steve Gerber and Mary Skrenes and originally published by DC Focus, a short-lived imprint of DC Comics. The aim of the imprint was to feature super-powered characters who did not follow the traditional format of classic superhero adventures. "Hard Time"<nowiki>'s</nowiki> first run was 12 issues long, published from April 2004 to March 2005. The series returned from hiatus in December 2005, titled "Hard Time: Season Two". With the demise of DC Focus, this run was published under the unfocused DC bullet. DC announced "Hard Time"'s cancellation in March
